rules: Freeze and remotely checkpoint complete reconciled source before recording acceptance.
Use the just-saved exact current commit for each subsequent gate; no commits, dependency resolution, checkout changes or source edits while a gate runs.
Record raw output and machine suite manifests with record_gate.py, retain failures, and save each completed gate immediately with [skip ci].
The changed shared Office source justifies rerunning existing complete selected cohorts plus the narrowly added suites.
Run engine scripted_workflows_test before the independent Office oracle; retain the actual 12 produced documents.
Do not wait for or restart Actions.
Keep navigation preview run separate from ordinary app counts and inspect the two genuine PNGs and font/source receipts.
No native-hook disabling or fake library substitution.
Do not execute external local-corpus harnesses or count their empty/no-input behavior as acceptance.
